Case &salaTurno3.ToString().Trim() = "T" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "Tarde"

EndCase EndIf EndCase EndIf EndIf EndIf If not (&TFsalaLocCodigo_Sel.IsEmpty()) WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Local") &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = &TFsalaLocCodigo_SelDsc

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
&VisibleColumnCount = 0 If &Session.Get(!'trnssalasWWColumnsSelector') <> '' &ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'trnssalasWWColumnsSelector') &ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML) Else Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector' EndIf
&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order') For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName)) &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11 &VisibleColumnCount += 1 EndIf EndFor

EndSub
Sub 'WriteData'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
For each trnssalas order salaLocCodigo salaTurno salaNumero when &OrderedBy = 1 order salaLocCodigo when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaLocCodigo) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaNumero when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaNumero) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaTurno when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaTurno) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaAlunos when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaAlunos) when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaStatus when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaStatus) when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
using trnssalasWWDS(&DynamicFiltersSelector1, &DynamicFiltersOperator1, &salaTurno1, &salaLocCodigo1, &salaNumero1, &salaStatus1 , &DynamicFiltersEnabled2, &DynamicFiltersSelector2, &DynamicFiltersOperator2, &salaTurno2, &salaLocCodigo2, &salaNumero2 , &salaStatus2, &DynamicFiltersEnabled3, &DynamicFiltersSelector3, &DynamicFiltersOperator3, &salaTurno3, &salaLocCodigo3 , &salaNumero3, &salaStatus3, &TFsalaLocCodigo, &TFsalaLocCodigo_Sel, &TFsalaNumero, &TFsalaNumero_Sel , &TFsalaTurno_Sels, &TFsalaAlunos, &TFsalaAlunos_To, &TFsalaStatus_Sels) Where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo
// Write cell values &CellRow += 1
Do 'BeforeWriteLine' &VisibleColumnCount = 0 For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True Do Case Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'salaLocCodigo' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(locDescricao) Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'salaNumero' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(salaNumero) Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'salaTurno' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = "A" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Almoço"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = "I" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Integral"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = "M" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Manhã"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = "N" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Noite"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = "T" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Tarde"
EndCase Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'salaAlunos' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = salaAlunos Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'salaStatus' &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = '' do Case Case salaStatus.ToString().Trim() = "A" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Ativo"
Case salaStatus.ToString().Trim() = "I" &ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = "Inativo"
EndCase EndCase &VisibleColumnCount += 1 EndIf EndFor
Do 'AfterWriteLine'
Endfor
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
EndSub
